text:
samir: Kicking off a config-only deploy to enforce new per-tenant speed_limit=120 and reduce kv_ttl to 12h. Short change window 10m starting now. Pinged canary.

deploy-bot: Deploy started (config-only) by @samir. Change window: 10m. Canary: routing-group=canary-42. :rocket:

maria: adding note — this touches routing rules + batcher concurrency. Watch queue latency + p95/p99 token latency.

alex: oncall? @olivia can you eyeball infra dashboards for cache pressure in the first 5m?

olivia: looking now. I'll monitor Redis memory and kvcache hit rate. If kvcache hit < 80% in 3m, we rollback.

maria: quick snippet for the guard: `curl -X POST /admin/pin -d '{"route":"tts","version":"v2.3.1"}'`

samir: config payload applied: `speed_limit: 120`, `batch_max_inflight: 8`, `kv_ttl_hours: 12`

deploy-bot: Canary completed: 2/2 success. Metrics: p95 latency +3%, request success rate 99.9%. No errors in logs.

olivia: seeing a small spike in outbound Redis ops +18%. kvcache hit rate steady at 86%. Memory up 4% — within expected.

alex: rolling out to 10% traffic now. Watch error budget and connection resets.

maria: heads up — observed rare `HANDOFF_TIMEOUT` on legacy routes at 2 instances. They're transient, investigating.

samir: scaling down batch_max_inflight to 6 for legacy routes via emergency pin: `route:legacy*,batch_max_inflight:6`

deploy-bot: Rollout to 10% complete. No SLO breaches. Continue to 50%? Reply with :thumbsup: to continue.

olivia: :thumbsup: go to 50. I'll keep watch, will signal rollback if redis ops >25% or error rate >1% sustained 2m.

alex: moving to 50% now.

deploy-bot: Progress: 50% traffic. Metrics: p99 lat +1.2%, error rate 0.12%.

maria: nothing concerning. Marking release notes: "Config: speed limit set to 120, batch inflight cap reduced for legacy routes, kvcache TTL lowered to 12h. Canary ok."

samir: leaving a pin on routing for `tenant=enterprise_*` to preserve v2.3.1 for 24h: `pin duration:24h`

olivia: good call. I'll keep monitoring next 30m then unwedge.

samir: thanks all. Closing change window in 8m. If no flags, we'll promote to 100% after.

oncall-bot: Reminder: change window ends in 8 minutes. If rollback required, post `rollback` in this thread.

alex: noted. No rollback needed. :white_check_mark:
